job: Compare plans or products feature by feature in a table, one column at a time on a phone.
purpose: An fd-table in a plain fd-table-wrap: features as rows grouped under fd-table-group heads, plans as columns, a header row that sticks under the site header, check and dash cells with text alternatives. On a phone fd-tabs choose the one plan column shown (data-show, site.js). versus has two columns, us and an alternative, with text cells.
useWhen: Under pricing when plans differ in many ways.
Ember against the way people do the job today (versus).

avoidWhen.when: Three or four plans that differ in a few ways.

states.name: column shown
states.how: data-show="n" on the section (site.js, from the tabs)

variants.useWhen: Two columns with sentences: the product and its alternative.
Set by site.js: the plan column shown on a phone.

parts.role: The fd-tabs that choose a column on a phone.
A check, with "Included" for screen readers.

keyboard.does: In the tabs: choose the plan shown on a phone.
